turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the past simple with -ed?
turns.tutor:
Hi! Of course. Regular verbs in the past simple end in -ed: I visited my uncle. She watched a film. The verb is the same for I, you, he, she, we and they.

Exercise: Write the past simple of the verb:
Last weekend we ___ (clean) the house.
